purpose: Compact offline knowledge base for government support that may be relevant after a severe or critical crop-health prediction.

rank_by: scheme type directly related to crop loss
recommendation_policy.if_eligibility_cannot_be_verified: Do not claim eligibility. Either show 'Potentially relevant' with a verification warning or return no recommendation.

ui_copy.disclaimer: This is a potential support pathway, not a confirmed claim or entitlement. Final eligibility, notified crop, area, season, enrollment and loss assessment must be verified with the official department or insurer.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.why_relevant: Potential crop-insurance support when the crop and area are notified for the relevant season and the farmer satisfies the insurance and loss-assessment conditions.
hard_gates: Crop is notified in the relevant insurance unit
Loss falls within the scheme's covered risk and assessment mechanism
schemes.important_warning: A disease prediction alone does not establish an insurance claim.

schemes.name: PMFBY - Tamil Nadu implementation
schemes.why_relevant: Tamil Nadu implements PMFBY through state notifications specifying crops, insurance units and seasons.
schemes.important_warning: Do not show this as automatically eligible merely because the model predicted a severe disease.

schemes.name: Kerala Restructured State Crop Insurance Scheme
schemes.why_relevant: Kerala provides crop-loss insurance/compensation for covered crops. The 2025 implementation circular specifically provides a pest/disease-loss pathway for paddy.
schemes.disease_rule: For pest/disease loss, the cited 2025 Kerala circular specifically identifies rice/paddy; do not generalize that disease-loss provision to tomato, potato or corn.
schemes.important_loss_rule: The cited circular states partial damage is not taken into account and paddy compensation is provided when crop loss is more than 50%.

schemes.name: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) - Kerala
schemes.why_relevant: Weather-index insurance can be relevant where a notified crop and season are covered and the loss is associated with covered adverse weather conditions.
hard_gates: Crop and season must be notified
Applicable insurance unit and weather trigger
schemes.crop_note: The Kerala 2025-26 Annual Plan lists tomato under Rabi RWBCIS and potato in Idukki under the listed Rabi crops; exact current notification must still be checked.

schemes.name: PMFBY - Uttar Pradesh implementation
schemes.why_relevant: The Uttar Pradesh Government cabinet decision for PMFBY/RWBCIS implementation identifies paddy, maize and potato among crops covered under the state implementation period described in the order.

english_interpretation_of_official_up_so.paddy_rice: Included under PMFBY crop coverage described in the UP Government decision.
english_interpretation_of_official_up_so.maize_corn: Included under PMFBY crop coverage described in the UP Government decision.
english_interpretation_of_official_up_so.potato: Included under PMFBY crop coverage described in the UP Government decision.
english_interpretation_of_official_up_so.tomato: Do not automatically map tomato to UP PMFBY. The UP decision separately discusses tomato under weather-based insurance in selected districts; current notification must be checked.

schemes.important_warning: The English text above is a structured interpretation of the official Hindi government decision for application use; it is not a replacement for the official notification.

schemes.name: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) - Uttar Pradesh
schemes.why_relevant: Potential support where a crop is notified under weather-based insurance and the relevant weather trigger and insurance conditions are met.
schemes.tomato_note: The UP Government decision separately references tomato under RWBCIS in selected districts; do not display it as statewide tomato coverage.

schemes.name: Dr. YSR Free Crop Insurance - PMFBY
schemes.why_relevant: Andhra Pradesh's crop-insurance implementation provides financial protection for notified crops in notified insurance units. Official AP material identifies paddy and maize among notified crops in multiple districts/seasons.
hard_gates: Current AP notified crop and insurance unit
e-Panta/e-crop record or current enrollment mechanism
Applicable Aadhaar/e-KYC or other current verification
schemes.crop_note: Do not assume tomato or potato coverage without a current AP notification for the relevant district and season.

schemes.name: Andhra Pradesh Natural Calamity Crop-Loss Assistance / Input Support
schemes.why_relevant: AP agriculture field-level procedures include assessment of crop damage from natural calamities and implementation of natural-calamity assistance/input support when government conditions are activated.
hard_gates: Official declaration/activation or applicable calamity conditions
Current government norms and relief package
schemes.important_warning: A disease prediction by itself is not proof of eligibility. This pathway is for officially assessed crop loss under applicable relief conditions.

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH) - Andhra Pradesh
schemes.why_relevant: Horticulture support can become relevant when severe crop damage leads to an eligible re-establishment, protected cultivation, vegetable or horticulture-development need under a currently active AP component.
schemes.important_warning: This is development/subsidy support, not automatic disease-loss compensation. Do not display it merely because tomato disease confidence is high.

no_recommendation_rules: Severity is low, moderate, unknown or missing.
State is missing for state-specific schemes.
The scheme does not match the selected crop.
Required current notification/insurance unit/season cannot be established.
The prediction only indicates disease presence but there is no evidence of qualifying crop loss.
Do not use a generic farmer-benefit scheme merely because disease severity is high.
implementation_note: This KB is intentionally conservative. Government schemes are not an AI prediction. They are deterministic recommendations from structured official-source rules. Current state notifications must override this static KB when available.
